question: Repeated provider funding with the guarded blob workflow
evidence_class: Source review plus existing native tests; no deployed provider observation
outcome: Confirmed missing authoritative credit settlement; first positive acceptance blocks the next guarded top-up

source.head: ebd535eaa2015407319fd330f559b2808ea01588
source.note: Maintainer-selected lock now differs from the earlier 0.27.0 media preflight; that historical record is unchanged. No dependency selection performed in this review.

findings.fact: Any accepted amount or reserved/uncertain attachment yields FundingActivity::Uncertain
Guarded preparation maps that activity to JournalUncredited, even with external host activity Clear
Guarded first-attempt marking also refuses earlier accepted cycles; low-level prepare cannot be used as a workaround
Persistent phases and mutation APIs record preparation, attempted uncertainty and exact callback/refund; no durable provider-credit reconciliation transition or confirmation mutation exists
Settled dispatch result is local transport accounting, not verified credit; success/balance reports do not clear credit evidence
Standalone funding endpoints are read-only history, outcome and preparation assessment; production host evidence acquisition and automatic funding dispatch are not exposed
Upload completion verifier is an independent authority and does not reconcile funding credit

consumer_review.wrapper: canic_blob_service::canister!(); local wrapper exposes funding inspection only
consumer_review.automatic_component_topup: Configured Canic top-ups fund component canister cycles via management deposit_cycles; this is separate from provider Cashier/account credit
consumer_review.limit: No deployed Toko timer, provider top-up or live failure observed. Tagged 0.14.9 sources reviewed locally, not registry archive rebuilt.

required_work: Define and implement an authenticated, exactly scoped durable credit-reconciliation transition; preserve original transport evidence, lifetime accounting, replay identity and restore fences; qualify how the provider establishes credit. Then integrate repeated provider top-ups in the consumer-owned wrapper/timer. A caller flag, balance report, new operation ID or journal reset cannot substitute for that work.
cleanup: Native processes exited; source snapshots and logs retained. No provider object, balance, journal or owner changed.
limitations: This verifies the guarded journal path, not every low-level funding primitive or all blob uploads.
Provider-specific credit evidence and full consumer publication/service qualification remain open.
This review does not implement reconciliation or qualify deployed provider behavior.
